title: Gateway Energy Storage System: CPUC Resolution E-5428: Gateway Thermal Event and Partial Return
summary: CPUC Resolution E-5428 records a thermal event at Gateway, ongoing CPUC and EPA root-cause investigations, an EPA settlement, and a partial return to service. Entity test: The later official record challenges any assumption that nameplate capacity represented uninterrupted operation.
key_findings: The later regulator record directly exposes incident and partial-operation conditions that the capacity-only panel could not show.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests facility operating history, maintenance, incident, and dispatch-condition alternatives.
Compatibility: Same named asset and incident; the records do not expose a full-capacity availability denominator or compatible dispatch series.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: The resolution does not supply a common availability denominator, full restored capacity, cycle count, degradation, revenue, or customer-reliability outcome.
Incident and partial-return status are independently attributable; full closure and performance remain unresolved.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
